Refs OVD-923
Fixes OVD-932

Built-by: Engineer / Codex (gpt via codex exec, ChatGPT plan), repair round 1 of 2; prior builder Codex at dc145bfb

## Linear issue ID

- Issue: Refs OVD-923; Fixes OVD-932 (the export-evals unvalued-record count, filed by Lead and covered by this PR's repair round 1) (OVD-923 is a child of OVD-894; supersedes the OVD-902 collector ticket). https://linear.app/overdrafter/issue/OVD-923
- Does this one bounded change satisfy the named issue's source acceptance criteria? Yes, as re-scoped on Oct 17. OVD-923 now covers the collector, the ledger, the per-PR computation, the export-evals unvalued count and a green SonarCloud gate; both are delivered in repair round 1. The original AC2 report sections, AC3 and AC4 moved to the child issues OVD-926, OVD-927 and OVD-928 (owned by Evaluator). Jev triage routed this ticket as `oversized`, which is why it was split.
- Is this the issue's main PR? Yes. It is the first PR for OVD-923.
- Confirm the named issue is not a release-outcome parent. Confirmed: OVD-923 is a tooling child of OVD-894.

## Summary

Adds `scripts/spend-ledger.mjs` (`collect`, `weekly`, `export-evals`) on top of a pure, tested module `scripts/lib/spend-ledger.mjs`. Token Watcher's per-pool daily usage becomes an idempotent JSONL spend ledger. From that ledger the script computes ISO-week dollars per merged PR for the codex, claude, cursor and jev pools and overall. Missing pools, partial coverage, zero-merge weeks and unknown attribution are reported explicitly and never shown as zero.

## Problem

PR #835's weekly evals report shows cost per PR as "not available" because no spend ledger exists. That means the +25% cost stop rule can't be evaluated. There was also no documented format for Token Watcher's usage data and no per-pool $/merged-PR figure.

## Acceptance criteria addressed

- [x] Collector pulls per-pool usage from a documented Token Watcher input (`token-watcher-usage.v1`: pool, period, tokens, dollars or subscriptionShare + subscriptionUsd, source, optional pr/issue/bot/model).
- [x] Included/subscription usage is valued at share × plan price, never as free. Records with no valuation are `unvalued` (usd null), never 0.
- [x] PR → pool attribution uses an explicit attribution map (the adapter boundary for #841 botAttribution and the OVD-919 substitution log), `model:`/`pool:` labels and bot names. Unknown or conflicting attribution stays `unknown` and is never guessed.
- [x] Weekly $/merged PR per pool and overall, per ISO week. Zero-merge weeks report `no-merges` (ratio null), missing pool data reports `unknown`/`missingPools`, partial coverage reports a lower bound, and small samples report `low-sample`.
- [x] PR #835-compatible ledger export (`export-evals`) so the existing stop rule can use real spend.
- [x] export-evals makes the unvalued/dropped record count visible in its output, not just on stderr (OVD-932): every exported line carries `exportUnvaluedRecords` and `exportComplete`. #835's `loadLedger` @76c5c038 still accepts every line because it ignores extra fields. A ledger whose records are all unvalued exits 3 instead of producing an empty export that could be read as $0.
- [x] Key normalization: attribution bots `opus` and `sonnet` (case-insensitive) and the labels `model:opus` and `model:sonnet` resolve to the claude pool. `model:opus` together with `model:codex` is still `conflicting`, and `opus`/`sonnet` are not accepted as pool values.
- [x] SonarCloud S4036 (scripts/spend-ledger.mjs, previously L41 and L102): git and gh are resolved once from the fixed directories /usr/bin, /bin, /usr/local/bin and /opt/homebrew/bin. They run by absolute path with `env` set to only `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` and `HOME` from os.homedir(), so the parent environment is not passed through. If gh is missing, the run exits 2 with a `--prs-json` hint. Nothing was marked Safe or won't-fix in Sonar.
- [ ] Weekly report narrative, Opus share, intervention count, routing recommendation and experiment stop criteria moved to OVD-926, OVD-927 and OVD-928 (Evaluator).

## Files changed

- `scripts/lib/spend-ledger.mjs`: pure validation, valuation, merge, ISO-week and attribution logic, plus weekly computation and markdown/export rendering
- `scripts/spend-ledger.mjs`: CLI (fs, optional read-only `gh pr list` via execFileSync argument arrays; git and gh are resolved by absolute path from fixed standard directories and run with a minimal PATH)
- `scripts/spend-ledger.test.mjs`: 44 vitest tests
- `scripts/fixtures/spend-ledger/*`: synthetic fixtures (README marks them as not real usage or prices)
- `docs/spend-ledger.md`: input schema, ledger location and format, CLI, output schema, edge cases, open questions for Token Watcher
- `package.json`: `spend:ledger` script
- `.gitignore`: `evals/spend-ledger/*.jsonl`, because real ledgers are not committed to this public repo

## Scope

Included: collector, canonical ledger (`evals/spend-ledger/ledger.jsonl` under the repo root by default, gitignored), weekly `spend-per-pr.v1` JSON or markdown, and the #835 export.
Not included: fetching Token Watcher data or #841/OVD-919 data automatically (those are file inputs), the Evaluator report, routing changes (pace-only routing stays the rule), and any real spend numbers. No workflow, secret, Supabase, migration or dependency changes.

## Verification

Commands run:

```bash
npx vitest run scripts/spend-ledger.test.mjs
npx eslint scripts/lib/spend-ledger.mjs scripts/spend-ledger.mjs scripts/spend-ledger.test.mjs
npm run preflight
```

Results:

- [x] all listed verification passed
- [x] unrelated baseline failures are described below

Baseline failures or exceptions: `npm run preflight` lint PASS and typecheck PASS. The test stage had 12829 passing, 19 skipped and 3 failing. All 3 failures are in `scripts/qualify-ovd417-four-migration-suffix.test.mjs` and are the known docker-only OVD-417 failures ("qualification stopped: requires ..."), which are unrelated to this change.

## Proof

Test: scripts/spend-ledger.test.mjs
Command: npx vitest run scripts/spend-ledger.test.mjs
```text
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  44 passed (44)
```

## Review findings and coverage

- Final PR head SHA: 4a70d533
- Sonar issue findings: https://sonarcloud.io/project/issues?id=optomachina_Overdrafter&pullRequest=845. At dc145bfb there were 13 open findings and the gate was ERROR (new_security_rating 2), caused by the S4036 findings at L41 and L102. Both are fixed in code in this round (absolute paths, minimal PATH); nothing was dispositioned in Sonar. The S8786 regex finding (lib L151) is also fixed. Still open as code smells: S3776 cognitive complexity (CLI `main`, lib `usageToLedger`) and the S3358 nested ternaries. Re-analysis at 4a70d533: quality gate OK (new_security_rating 1, hotspots 100% reviewed), 10 open findings, all code smells and no vulnerabilities.
- CodeRabbit: rate limited again at 4a70d533 (status "Review rate limited"), so it has not reviewed this head.
- Codex and other reviewers: QA FAILed dc145bfb on the Sonar gate. This repair has not been reviewed yet; Lead dispatches reviewers.
- [ ] Inspected findings and threads on the final head; actionable current-change findings are resolved or have evidence-backed dispositions. Missing or stale review is not counted as clean.

## Tests

- Added `scripts/spend-ledger.test.mjs` (44 tests; repair round 1 added 11 covering export completeness fields, exit 3 for all-unvalued, the #835 `loadLedger` acceptance rule, opus/sonnet normalization and conflicts, and absolute-path resolution with a minimal PATH and the gh-missing hint). It covers input validation with file:line errors, subscription-share valuation, unvalued records, idempotent and order-independent merge, field whitelisting, ISO weeks including 2026-W53, window clipping, no-merge, missing, partial and low-sample weeks, attribution conflicts, markdown never printing $0.00 for missing data, #835 export compatibility, and the CLI with an injected gh runner and the 1000-result truncation guard.

## Migration notes

- [x] No migration impact
- [ ] Migration impact exists and is described below

## Rollback / risk notes

- Risk: low. This is a local read-only tooling script with no production, database or auth path. The only network use is an optional read-only `gh pr list`.
- Rollback: revert this PR. No data or config depends on it.

## Documentation

- [x] Docs updated
- [ ] No doc updates needed

## Follow-up items

- [ ] OVD-926: weekly report from `spend-per-pr.v1` (cost per merged PR per pool and overall, first-try CI, interventions, Opus share).
- [ ] OVD-927: routing recommendation section (advisory; pace-only routing stays until Blaine approves a change).
- [ ] OVD-928: stop criteria for experiments OVD-911 to OVD-918 tied to cost per merged PR.
- [ ] OVD-930: #841 trust snapshot needs per-PR attribution to feed `pr-pool-attribution.v1`.
- [ ] Token Watcher: emit `token-watcher-usage.v1` and answer the open questions in `docs/spend-ledger.md`.
title: OVD-923: spend-ledger collector and weekly dollars per merged PR
